text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I beat... Ikuno...!
Yes, I did it—!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It still needs some adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today,
Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's with the sudden formality~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I went into this 'Yasuda Kinen'
in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I still lost.
It would be a lie to say I'm not frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot stay down in the dumps forever. Especially not when I have someone as positive as you by my side.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again next time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Teehee.
No, thank YOU."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's a place I'd like to stop by
on the way back, would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's a super sento public bath.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Public baths are expected to offer various relaxing effects, including thermal and hydrostatic pressure benefits.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Relaxation brings better sleep and focus,
which in turn helps prevent tomorrow's injuries—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "heal when you're tired."
This cycle is the key to your future health.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I seeee!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's go right away.
Soaking for too long has the opposite effect, so don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~, so warm and toasty.
I feel warm right down to my core~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll sleep well tonight...
*yaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that.
...Please don't fall asleep here, okay?

In any case, warming both body and mind at the public bath,
the two gained vitality for what lay ahead.
